abstract: Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma is an extremely rare tumor in men, with 13 cases reported in the literature. Due to its rarity, primary choriocarcinoma of the lung in men is often incorrectly diagnosed as more common diseases, such as primary or metastatic lung cancer, and therefore potentially curative chemotherapy or surgery may be withheld from the patient. In this report, we present the case of a 23-year-old man with hemoptysis and progressive dyspnea. Airspace consolidation with multiple nodules of varying sizes was found on a chest radiograph. The results of a urine pregnancy test were positive, and the beta-human chorionic gonadotropin level was markedly elevated both in the serum and the urine. Subsequently, testing of a bronchoscopic biopsy specimen proved these tumors to be choriocarcinoma. We conclude that the urine pregnancy test, a simple and convenient method, would be very useful in the rapid diagnosis of primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma in men.
abstract_ja: 男性の原発性肺絨毛癌は極めて稀な腫瘍であり、文献上の報告は13例のみである。症例が稀であるため、男性の原発性肺絨毛癌はしばしば原発性または転移性肺癌などのより一般的な疾患と誤診され、根治を目指せる化学療法や外科的切除が控えられることがある。本報告では、23歳男性が喀血と進行性の呼吸困難を呈した症例を提示する。胸部X線写真では、大きさの異なる多発結節を伴う肺胞性浸潤が認められた。尿妊娠検査は陽性で、β-hCG値は血清および尿中で著明に上昇していた。その後、気管支鏡下生検標本の検査により腫瘍は絨毛癌と判明した。簡便で手軽な尿妊娠検査は、男性の原発性肺絨毛癌の迅速診断に極めて有用であると結論する。
